title: flirt
description: FLIRT (FMRIB's Linear Image Registration Tool) is a fully automated robust and accurate tool for linear (affine) intra- and inter-modal brain image registration.

out_matrix_file.description: Output affine matrix in 4x4 asciii format.
out_matrix_file.title: Out matrix file

apply_isoxfm.description: As applyxfm but forces isotropic resampling.
apply_isoxfm.title: Apply isoxfm

apply_xfm.description: Apply transformation supplied by in_matrix_file or uses_qform to use the affine matrix stored in the reference header.
apply_xfm.title: Apply xfm

bbrtype.description: 'signed' or 'global_abs' or 'local_abs'. Type of bbr cost function: signed [default], global_abs, local_abs.
bbrtype.title: Bbrtype

bgvalue.description: Use specified background value for points outside fov.
bgvalue.title: Bgvalue

cost.description: 'mutualinfo' or 'corratio' or 'normcorr' or 'normmi' or 'leastsq' or 'labeldiff' or 'bbr'. Cost function.
cost.title: Cost

cost_func.description: 'mutualinfo' or 'corratio' or 'normcorr' or 'normmi' or 'leastsq' or 'labeldiff' or 'bbr'. Cost function.
cost_func.title: Cost func

datatype.description: 'char' or 'short' or 'int' or 'float' or 'double'. Force output data type.
datatype.title: Datatype

dof.description: Number of transform degrees of freedom.
dof.title: Dof

echospacing.description: Value of epi echo spacing - units of seconds.
echospacing.title: Echospacing

fieldmap.description: Fieldmap image in rads/s - must be already registered to the reference image.
fieldmap.title: Fieldmap

force_scaling.description: Force rescaling even for low-res images.
force_scaling.title: Force scaling

interp.description: 'trilinear' or 'nearestneighbour' or 'sinc' or 'spline'. Final interpolation method used in reslicing.
interp.title: Interp

min_sampling.description: Set minimum voxel dimension for sampling.
min_sampling.title: Min sampling

no_resample_blur.description: Do not use blurring on downsampling.
no_resample_blur.title: No resample blur

no_search.description: Set all angular searches to ranges 0 to 0.
no_search.title: No search

padding_size.description: For applyxfm: interpolates outside image by size.
padding_size.title: Padding size

rigid2D.description: Use 2d rigid body mode - ignores dof.
rigid2D.title: Rigid2d

searchr_x.description: Search angles along x-axis, in degrees.
searchr_x.title: Searchr x

searchr_y.description: Search angles along y-axis, in degrees.
searchr_y.title: Searchr y

searchr_z.description: Search angles along z-axis, in degrees.
searchr_z.title: Searchr z

wm_seg.description: White matter segmentation volume needed by bbr cost function.
wm_seg.title: Wm seg

wmcoords.description: White matter boundary coordinates for bbr cost function.
wmcoords.title: Wmcoords

wmnorms.description: White matter boundary normals for bbr cost function.
wmnorms.title: Wmnorms
